methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected on 2026-06-14 from each provider's official pricing page where it returned usable content, and from reputable 2026 comparison pages (primarily aura.com/learn) where the official page returned 403/404. LifeLock pricing was fetched from lifelock.norton.com/plans (official, confirmed on two separate fetches). Aura pricing was fetched from aura.com/plans (official). Identity Guard pricing was fetched from identityguard.com/plans (official, confirmed on two separate fetches). IDShield's official idshield.com/plans and idshield.com/individual/ both returned 403, so pricing was taken from aura.com comparison pages (idshield-vs-lifelock and is-idshield-worth-it), which agreed exactly: $14.95/$19.95 individual, $29.95/$34.95 family. IdentityForce's official identityforce.com returned 403; pricing was taken from aura.com/learn/is-identityforce-legit ($19.90/$34.90 individual) and corroborated by aura.com/learn/identityforce-vs-lifelock (identical figures). An older aura.com best-protection roundup showed lower figures ($17.99/$23.99), likely stale; the dedicated review page figures are used. Zander Insurance pricing was fetched from zanderins.com/id-theft/ (official). Experian IdentityWorks Premium price ($24.99/mo) was confirmed on experian.com/consumer-products/identity-theft-protection.html; the Plus plan price could not be extracted from any reachable official or comparison page and is set to null. HIPAA/BAA are not applicable to consumer identity theft protection and are null throughout. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null on every plan (non-telephony). annualDiscountPct is calculated from published monthly vs annual-billed-monthly figures where both are available.
